scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node app/scripts/postbuild-copy.js
scripts.pack:dir: npm run sync:logo && npx electron-builder@26.0.12 --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:deb: npm run sync:logo && npx electron-builder@26.0.12 --linux deb --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:windows: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run prepare:speech && npm run sync:logo && node scripts/build-windows.js
scripts.test:windows: npm run build && node --test tests/windows-runtime.test.cjs && node tests/windows-connection.test.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run prepare:speech && npm run sync:logo && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.windows.yml
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run prepare:speech && npm run sync:logo && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.windows.yml
scripts.test:speech: node --use-env-proxy scripts/prepare-speech-test.js && npm run build && node tests/speech.test.cjs
